content: Metrics To measure the prediction accuracy, we used Jaccard Similarity Score (Jaccard), Average F1 (F1) and Precision Recall AUC (PR-AUC). Jaccard is defined as the size of the intersection divided by the size of the union of ground truth set $Y_t^{(k)}$ and predicted set $\hat{Y}_t^{(k)}$ .
